# Shot-location audit references

IMG_0974.PNG–IMG_0977.PNG are the exact four screenshots uploaded in Archive 3.zip. They show SML v Naomh Ciaran and Rynaghs v Shamrocks in History H1/Full Match views. They are visual evidence, not exported event records. They cannot establish event IDs, stored coordinates, or the capture action that produced individual far-end marks.

canonical-top.json and canonical-bottom.json are explicitly controlled, anonymised representative saved-match fixtures, NOT reconstructions or exports of those real matches. Each includes the physical tap samples and stored canonical coordinates produced by the existing attackingDirection/transformLocation capture convention for both teams and both halves. Unit tests check those semantics; browser tests independently use the real Live Match capture UI and actual History/report rendering.

No team/player vocabulary or photo-specific assignments are added to production code. No historical location is inferred or repaired from these screenshots.
